lead: `--EXPECT-ERROR--` means "this run must fail", so a program that exits 0 cannot assert its stderr.
body: `crates/nvs-test/src/run.rs` reports `expected the run to fail, and it succeeded` before comparing the stderr you wrote, which bites `Core\Debug::dump`, which writes only there. End the program with a deliberate `throw new RuntimeError(...)` and absorb the fatal report with a trailing `%A`.

until.arg: crates/nvs-test/src/run.rs:expected the run to fail, and it succeeded
